_comment: A fire damage-over-time aura on the nearest enemy: reapplies every 20 ticks, and each new burn deals 10.5 HP plus 2.6111 per level over 3 ticks spaced 60 ticks apart. The cost only charges when a genuinely new burn starts, not on every 20-tick reapplication of an existing one; pricing it per reapplication instead would make the aura unaffordable. All values placeholder.
name: Immolate
